verdict.rationale: Muse is a consumer personal AI agent (chat/mobile/WhatsApp interface) for everyday tasks like shopping, finances, and health tracking, not a developer tool or platform expected to ship an official CLI; this is a category mismatch rather than a missing feature. Evidence even shows deliberate auth-walling of developer surfaces (401 on llms.txt/openapi.json) and no MCP/API discovery, reinforcing it is not positioned as a CLI-accessible product.
